reviews.title: Update 1.128.0 Broke My App
reviews.text:
The new 1.128.0 update completely broke the Canva desktop app on my Intel Mac running macOS 13.7.8 (Ventura). It crashes instantly upon opening before the window even loads.
Looking at the macOS crash report, the update introduced a new billing module (apple_billing_v2.node) that triggers a DYLD Symbol missing fatal error on macOS 13. Because this update was pushed through the Mac App Store to a system that can no longer run it, the desktop app is now completely unusable. Please either patch compatibility for macOS 13 Ventura or update the App Store minimum OS requirements so users on supported systems aren't forced into a broken build.

reviews.title: Outdated File Management
reviews.text:
One of my biggest frustrations with Canva is the lack of real-time image synchronization. If I start a project, upload an image, leave Canva to edit that image in another application, and then return to Canva, the library continues displaying the outdated version.

Canva does not automatically detect that an externally edited image has changed, even when the updated image has been saved over the original file. Instead, users have to manually re-upload the image, creating unnecessary duplicate files and additional steps in their workflow.

For a platform built around creative design and productivity, this is a significant inconvenience. At a minimum, Canva should offer automatic asset refresh, an option to synchronize externally modified files, or a simple way to update an existing library image without having to upload another copy.

Creative workflows should not require users to constantly work around outdated file management.

reviews.title: Glitches everywhere
reviews.text: Just worked hard on a video on the phone app for a while. Just before I went to download it, of course I find I made a typo. So I go into edit the animated text. The animation is now all messed up. So I close the app out, restart it and go back in. Animation is still glitching. Ok so I try again, closing it out, restarting then downloading to see if it’s just in the app that the animation isn’t working. Go into my photos hit play, and there is the video with the animation going crazy with glitches. I had planned on uploading this to my socials and don’t have my iPad or anything else to try and fix. I also don’t have another hour to spend on creating a new video. As a pro paid member shouldn’t even have to worry about this in the first place! It should work. Canva used to be so great before they integrated AI and other “improvements” to their app. It is so inconsistent with how well it works. One day I can get things done. The next day, it freezes, won’t give me guidelines for centering, refuses to download after an hour or two of working on an image, pushes printing options when I’m not designing to print on site, downloads incorrectly (ex. no transparency when it is toggled on), edit colors are completely off, and that’s just a handful of issues. I’m a pro member. Have been using Canva since day one when it was still completely free and a simple icon creator. The push for AI on here has ruined what this is supposed to be. NOT EVERY PERSON WANTS AI! Fix what’s broken and stop

reviews.title: The UI is an Afterthought
reviews.text:
Multiple UI elements in the editor cover each other. When trying to select something it will almost never select the correct thing if there is even the slightest overlap. Theres no way to select something underneath another element without manually sending the entire layer “to the back” so you can select what it was on top of.

One of the most egregious things Canva does is wholly ignore all edits made to a photo from your phone. If you use your photos app to edit something, especially using markdown to add shapes/other elements, Canva will elect to ignore them on import. The imported image will be automatically reverted to its unedited original with no way to change it back.

Theres just so many small issues with the UI it’s unbelievable. Actively hinders production and makes the entire process endlessly frustrating. Most of the “skill” in using Canva is just learning how to navigate the myriad of terribly designed UI elements.

It also encourages the use of AI slop. The app is literally trying to make you dependent on its slop generator. It wants you to lose your actual graphic design skills. Everything you make also gets automatically stolen and fed into their plagiarism machine.

reviews.title: Artificial (Not) Intelligence
reviews.text:
It is incredibly frustrating to watch an AI burn app through your limited teat credits on the exact same mistakes without ever learning from its previous attempts. Limiting users testing the product by the number of prompt attempts instead of successful completed images completely penalizes you for the AI's own mistakes. It is a terrible user experience and a terrible way to convince someone to upgrade.
Canva's image generator relies on a lighter, fast-processing AI engine that struggles heavily with complex scenes that contain more than three or four specific details.
If you want an AI image generator that actually follows complex, multi-object instructions without immediately locking you out or forcing an upgrade, there are better alternatives until they improve their AI and usage model.

But not Canva is shoving AI images down your throat and trying to get you to use their AI features. I want to make things by hand and use my brain. That’s why i use the product. I’ll just go back to sourcing images online and using open source software to build my projects.

reviews.title: Glitchy, unstable, and messy Ui
reviews.text: A large project I have been working on will not save.  The entire interface is basically a total mess at this point, and it feels like, as a paid user, Canva is still committing most of the usable space to promote design templates at me, rather than letting me see a clean organized work space.  I was just now fighting with a glitchy laggy reactions with the ipad app, and a popup appeared asking me to rate and review this service.  As a long time user, the platform has definitely gotten worse.  They just kept adding and adding more and more clutter, and the buttons move on you each time you look. One of the most basic functions I need is predictable access to an Uploads folder.  The button for the Uploads is all over the place.  It is on the left of the screen as I type this.  Sometimes it is hidden below the screen.  Other times it is on the top of the interface somewhere.  Other times it is missing altogether.  This platform is a total mess.  BUT, if you type LGBT in the search, it will flash rainbows at you.  So at least they have their priorities over there at Canva.

reviews.title: AI is Extreme, Wish There Was an AI Free Version
reviews.text:
I loved Canva when it first came out and used it extensively for years for my NGO in particular but also for other part-time jobs and consulting projects. But ever since it went from dipping its toes in AI to full on AI worshipper it has gone completely downhill and I try to avoid using it at all. I know technically you are supposed to be able to still use it without the AI features, but they have built them in so deeply they have made it impossible to get anything done without using AI. And I also know ethically and environmentally I’m not really making a difference if I still use an app this heavy into AI even if I avoid some obvious usage of AI, it is still underneath it all. Canva was perfectly great without AI, you guys are capable of designing an app that allows the average person to - I wont’t say graphic design because that is an actual profession with way more skills-but to make cohesively designed branding and presentation documents and some light video and photo
editing without the HUGE moral implications & rushing the planet towards destruction, just so startups can add a tiny animated video of a monkey to their newsletter!

reviews.title: Constantly crashes/refreshes
reviews.text: I'll be in the middle of editing slide 50 or so and then 5 minutes in it just refreshes randomly and takes me all the way back to slide 1. I have to go all the way back to where I was, and it can take ages for me to get back to what I was doing after the interruption. I'd say this refresh happens every 5-10 minutes. It's very frustrating. It doesn't happen from leaving the app or leaving my screen open for ages without touching it, it's literally just randomly while I'm in the middle of editing something. I'll add in a new picture, crop something, or change the colour of something, and out of no where the screen will flash white and it will take me all the way back to slide 1. Mind you I have something I'm making with over 100 slides so trying to get back to where I was is very time-consuming.

reviews.title: Buggy and Confusing
reviews.text: I’ve been using canva pro for work and it has been an uphill climb. I have clips on my phone, which I’ll try to edit on my computer by uploading to canva, which little did I know is actually a trap. Clip uploading starts by teasing you by showing you your entire clip, then turns your screen into a gradient white/grey loading screen. You literally can’t do anything but stare at it and it doesn’t even work. Waited for half an hour, gave up, came back 2 days later and it says the clip couldn’t be uploaded. So now I’m forced to do everything on my tiny phone screen which canva clearly wasn’t built for. Because now I’m trying to edit a clip by adding “elements”, which is another buggy issue because it ends up taking a horizontal tag I (somehow successfully) uploaded and blows up a small portion of it to take up the whole vertical project. Doesn’t even let me shrink it down or resize it either, just takes a general idea and doesn’t let me look at anything other than canva’s interpretation of what it should look like because it’s now taking up literally the whole project’s screen. It ends up taking about 20 minutes just to process a 1 minute video. I think I’ll try CapCut.

reviews.title: BUYER BEWARE!!!
reviews.text: I have been using Canva Pro and the free version since 2021. Mostly for stock photos and video footage to use as fillers on social media. I’ve never had any major issues with the company till now. I recently changed my niche. Now I need Ai generated images and video clips. Because of the years of trust I had for this company I don’t hesitate to buy a Canva Pro plan for another year. They were selling their AI model as superior and I believed it. Right after I make my payment to Apple I generated my first image. I could not believe how bad it was. I gave AI simple and direct instructions it still could not follow. The majority of the images I attempted to make came out distorted, backwards or some other odd and unnatural look. I tried multiple times to contact customer service, it’s not even possible. There is no human support anymore, only AI automated. I contacted Apple to get a refund, it was denied twice with no explanation. Even though Canva is selling a faulty AI product. I was also forewarned not to push refunds with Apple because they will strip you of access to all of your Google accounts including your email! Apple gets 30% of every subscription we buy. No wonder they want to keep your money. This has become a digital mafia. I will never again buy anything from Canva. Be careful what you buy that’s connected with Apple!!!

reviews.title: Poor upgrade policies
reviews.text:
I had a rather uncomfortable experience using the app. The overall usability didn’t meet expectations, and it felt restrictive in ways that impacted the experience.

What was particularly disappointing is the lack of flexibility when it comes to subscriptions. Once you choose a plan, there doesn’t seem to be an easy way to upgrade or switch to a better option. This limitation feels quite frustrating, especially when your needs evolve over time.

reviews.title: Slow Performance and Login Issues
reviews.text:
I tried using this app to create designs, but the experience was quite disappointing. The app opens very slowly and often gets stuck on the loading screen. The biggest issue is the login process — even after trying multiple times, the account either doesn’t log in or takes a very long time.

When an app can’t properly handle basic functions like opening and logging in, it’s natural for users to lose trust. This becomes especially frustrating when you need to create a design quickly and the app doesn’t respond.

reviews.title: Stupid feature ruins the entire app
reviews.text: This would be an immediate 5 stars but there is one issue that knocks it all the way down to one. When you open camera roll through Canva to select images it scatters them. Upon googling it has said that it’s sorting them through time taken but this cannot be true as I am using photos all taken at the same time consecutively and then sent to my device and saved and it is throwing them back to weeks ago in my camera roll making it near impossible to find them. This is a ridiculous “feature” making nothing easier and making the app almost impossible to use! There seems to be no fix or solution to this either.

reviews.title: Unremivable danger zone warning
reviews.text:
I used to love Canva, I pay full subscription, but without asking they’ve added “Danger zone” warning red boxes around all my designs. There is no way to remove them.

They block my view of what is behind them and impede my ability to properly design my image in the frame I have chosen to use. If I wanted a smaller frame I’d choose one. Why is there no way to get rid of the warnings???

They are for printing but (1) I never print the majority of my designs (2) If I am printing I want to design over the bleed zone, that is the whole point of it, so 
I can’t see what is there and if it is printed it still looks good.

This forced red boxes stops me from seeing what is under it properly and tricks my eye when assessing the overall design. I AM NOT PRINTING. A very very large number of users fall into the same category. Why are you forcing us to not be able to properly see or design our images? I m not printing!

This has ruined it for me, I want my money back.
